description: This file handles updating the user's timezone preference in the SuiteCRM application. It processes incoming POST or GET requests to set a new timezone setting for the current user, then saves it and redirects to the homepage.

classes.name: CurrentUser
classes.description: Represents the current user and manages user preferences.

methods.name: setPreference
methods.description: Sets a user preference, such as 'timezone'.

methods.name: savePreferencesToDB
methods.description: Persists user preferences to the database.
